description:
Job Summary:  

 The CPQ Application Developer/System Analyst is responsible for collecting requirements, design, development, testing, implementing and support of Configure, Price and Quote (CPQ) solutions throughout the enterprise.  This role will require working with Sales Operations, Product Offering Managers, and Engineers to capture the configuration requirements associated with different products and services to better understand the needs of the business and implement best-in-class CPQ solutions.

 The ideal candidate should have prior multiple implementation experiences of Oracle CPQ (BigMachines) system or equivalent, demonstrate strong technical skills, an understanding of business processes, a focus on user experience improvement, and a drive to improve sales effectiveness and efficiency through implementation and maintenance of Vertiv’s CPQ system. The CPQ Application Developer/System Analyst should have prior experience collecting, writing, and maintaining product and service configurator specification documentation and work with development teams to drive and execute results.

 The CPQ Application Developer/System Analyst will work to achieve streamlined processes, superior quality of service, and outstanding reliability and availability. The CPQ Application Developer/System Analyst must be a self-starter who can work with minimal supervision, able to work independently, comes with can-do , jump-right-in attitude. The ideal candidate must be a team player and capable of growing into leadership responsibilities. 

 This position will be be based onsite at our Vertiv Westerville, OH - HQ location.

 Responsibilities: 

 
 Documentation and Analysis Skills - Document business processes and translate requirements into technical specifications.  Collect, write, and maintain configurator specification documentation

 Developer Skills – Able to build new product configurators and maintain existing configurators using multiple programing languages such as BML, BMQL, SOAP, REST, JavaScript, CSS

 Communication Skills - Able to elicit and communicate requirements among stakeholders and present ideas in an easily comprehensible manner. Ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all organization levels

 Interaction Skills - Able to work in a team setting and assist stakeholders in articulating problems and opportunities. Ability to work independently and as a member of a team

 Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving Skills - Effectively identify business issues and opportunities, assess proposed solutions and meet stakeholder needs

 Testing Skills - Collaborate with Marketing and Engineering to ensure the testing and proofing of configuration models prior to release

 Learning Skills – Able to learn new skills through a combination of being self-taught and through training classes, but mainly a desire to be a continuous learner

 Software Applications- skilled in use of contemporary project management and office productivity platforms to facilitate collaboration and communication among developers and stakeholders 

 
 Requirements: 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field

 3 plus years of experience with CPQ platforms (Salesforce CPQ, Oracle CPQ, or similar)

 Experience collecting, writing, and maintaining configurator specification documentation

 Experience building new and complex product configurators, and maintaining existing configurators

 Experience in working with cross functional integrations between systems and in a highly cross functional environment

 Strong experience working with SaaS applications, including the ability to develop, extend, and debug cloud based solutions. 

 Hands on expertise with REST and SOAP APIs is required to build and integrate CPQ modules with surrounding enterprise systems

 Ability to work in a flexible and adaptable manner with shifting priorities

 Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust, inspire collaboration, and navigate cultural and geographic diversity

 Experience working in an agile development environment

 Proficient in Microsoft Office applications

 Experience using ServiceNow preferred but not required

 Oracle CPQ certification preferred but not required

 Experience in a manufacturing environment preferred but not required

 
 The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities. 

   OUR CORE PRINCIPLES : Safety.  Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork.  Inclusion.

   OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES 

 
 High-Performance Culture

 Customer Focus

 Operational Excellence

 Innovation

 Financial Strength

 
   VERTIV BEHAVIORS 

 
 Own it

 Act with urgency

 Foster a customer-first mindset

 Think big and execute

 Lead by example

 Drive continuous improvement

 Learn and seek out development

 Promote transparent & open communication

 
   About Vertiv 

 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.  Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.  

   Work Authorization 

 No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
